posts.title: Years to Weeks
posts.description: On Tuesday I reached for a command I built to review my code and found the model already did everything it did. The gap between building something custom and watching the platform absorb it used to be years. It is down to weeks.

posts.title: No Subscribers To Disappoint
posts.description: The channel is set up, the audience is already there, and I still haven't pressed record. The moment a thing becomes useful it stops being play and turns into something I owe.

posts.title: The Project I Said I Wouldn't Start
posts.description: I found years of old logbooks while hunting for my passport. Days later I was building a project I'd promised myself I wouldn't.
